name: Heated Floor Mats vs Loose Cable: Which Suits Your Room
title-tag: Heated Floor Mat vs Cable | Tile | Snoqualmie, WA
meta-description: Heated floor mats vs loose cable: which suits your room shape, what the electrician actually does, and the honest cost logic for Snoqualmie bathrooms.
post-summary: March 9, 2027 · Mats and loose cable make exactly the same warmth - the difference is how the wire gets onto your floor. Mats win in simple rectangular rooms, cable wins in L-shapes and chopped-up floors, and the thermostat and electrician cost the same either way. The full decision tree, plus the Snoqualmie winter argument for warm tile.
